Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Fill rows of lengths 1 through n using consecutive positive integers beginning at 1. Separate numbers with one space.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "1",
    "2 3",
    "4 5 6"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Keep the next unused number between rows.

Complexity: O(n^2 log(n+1)) output characters conservatively
